facts.fact: Vero 失踪第三天，Kayla 反复回放监控无果
facts.anchor: Three days Vero has been missing

facts.fact: Brawley 首次承认：不知道如何面对「不知道」
facts.anchor: I don’t know how to do this,” he confesses with a sigh. “The not knowing

facts.fact: Kayla 用芯片被切除反推 Vero 不想被找到，劝 Brawley 保重自己等他回来
facts.anchor: He removed his microchip, which means he doesn’t want to be found

facts.fact: Cipher 一人份的大量食物触发 Kayla 的联想，牵出棚屋线索
facts.anchor: He ordered a lot of food for one person, so I figured he must live with someone

facts.fact: Ares 与 Clay 确认：棚屋恰在监控盲区边缘，Khodi 搜查漏掉了它
facts.anchor: It sits just outside the dead zone

facts.fact: 棚屋里 Vero 对 Aaron 宣告「相处三天算室友」，刑讯进入日常节奏
facts.anchor: since we have spent three days together now, it basically makes us roommates

facts.fact: 恐慌第三次袭来：血腥与土味触发，Kayla 在气味清单里抓住 Clay 的味道着陆
facts.anchor: I can smell burning metal, oil, old wood, and Clay

facts.fact: Vero 逼 Aaron 最后看一眼 Kayla，宣告他永不再见到她
facts.anchor: Take one last look, because you will never see her again
